value.title: How to Load Scripts with async and defer in JavaScript
value.snippet: The defer and async attributes solve this problem by changing how and when scripts are downloaded and executed. Understanding the difference between them, and knowing which one to use in each situation, directly impacts how fast your pages load and how quickly users can interact with them.
